title: Home for the HoliGays Christmas Show
seo_title: Home for the HoliGays Christmas Show in Joplin, MO
description: Home for the HoliGays Christmas Show is a holiday evening of live music, a silent auction, raffles and holiday treats. Doors open at 6pm for bidding and treats, and the show starts at 7pm; cover is $15, or $10 with a new toy donated to Toys for Tots. It takes place December 5, 2026 (Time TBD) at Blackthorn Pizza & Pub, 510 S Joplin Ave in Joplin, MO, with the musical lineup to be announced.
